header.title: People v Buonincontri
caption: The People of the State of New York, Respondent,
v
Nicole Buonincontri, Appellant.

appearances.text: *Labe M. Richman*, New York City, for appellant.
*Michael E. Bongiorno*, *District Attorney*, New City (*Ellen O'Hara Woods* of counsel), for respondent.

disposition.text: The order of the Appellate Division should be affirmed. The defendant was informed on the record that she had the right to be present during questioning of a prospective juror concerning the ability to be fair and impartial. The Appellate Division properly determined that defendant failed to present an adequate record to overcome the presumption of regularity (*see People v Velasquez*, 1 NY3d 44, 48 [2003]).
